label: D2 after a common a2 -> S2 transition
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition. Both are visible inputs at D2 (in_action=2, in_state=2). Dev scores: P 0.98, R 0.97, F1 0.98, mass recall 0.995. It does not fire at D1 or GO, at S1, or after a rare a2->S1 or a1->S2 transition: in_state==2 alone gives P 0.77 and the rare a1->S2 case is almost always silent. It fires for both past rewards and it ignores the hidden good state, except through its correlation with choosing a2. Requiring that the previous choice was also a2 raises precision to 0.99 but drops recall to 0.72, so the feature does not need a stay. Magnitude was not checked rigorously. In the example windows it looks higher after a streak of rewarded a2/S2 trials and lower when the previous trial went unrewarded, and it is highest in the top value bin (rate 0.47). The predicate uses only variables observed at D2.

issues: Every claim checks out. Test split: P 0.982, R 0.972, F1 0.977, mass recall 0.995. The dev numbers reproduce exactly.
Phase claim holds: the feature has zero activations at D1 and GO, so all of its activation mass is at D2.
The rare cases are almost silent: a1->S2 rare gives P 0.08 and holds 0.5% of the mass; a2->S1 rare gives P 0.012. State==2 alone gives P 0.77, as the other agent stated.
Stay claim holds: also requiring the previous choice to be a2 gives P 0.993 but R 0.715.

The 'ignores the hidden good state' claim holds for whether the feature fires: good==S1 still gives P 0.95, and the recall split (0.67 for good==S2, 0.13 for good==S1) reflects how often the agent chooses a2.
Missed activations on test (4538 steps, 0.5% of the mass) are mostly weak, at 0.01 to 0.33 of the max, and mostly come from rare a1->S2 transitions. This is the low tail, not a systematic class.
False positives on test (2888 steps, about 1.8% of predictions) are scattered across reward, good-state and position patterns. No class stands out.
Minor caveat: the magnitude claims (higher after a streak of rewarded a2 trials) were not checked rigorously, but the label does not depend on them.
